fab_and_structure: JLCPCB, HDI 2-step at 6 layers = the brief's Structure B: stacked laser microvias Top->L2-GND->L3-SIG and Bottom->L5-VCC3V3->L4-SIG (two objects at one XY, copper-filled and planarized per JLC), buried mechanical L3-SIG->L4-SIG 0.15/0.27 through the 0.930 core only once JLC have priced it ("Buried Via Fee / Lamination Fee: Manual Quote"), through vias 0.20/0.35 unchanged, planes kept, placed copper untouched (0 of 1518 tracks change). Stacked rather than staggered because U1's legal in-field sites (87) are the binding resource and a staggered pair spends two of them. PCBWay refused: only 1+N+1 is priceable ($495.01 qty 5, +$185.67 over JLC), 2+N+2 not priceable, no published 6L HDI stack, via-in-pad +$126-170. 1-step (Structure A) refused: it rips 288 inner tracks / 857.8 mm / 50 nets incl. all 39 SDRAM nets (brief). JLC's 6L 2-step layer pairs (L1-L3 / L4-L6 by analogy with their 8L example) are fab question 1.
stack: JLCH061611N2-2116 ordered BY NAME, as JLC publish it (jlcpcb_hdi_facts.md): L1 0.035 / PP2116 0.112 / L2 0.030 / PP2116 0.112 / L3 0.030 / core 0.930 / L4 0.030 / PP2116 0.112 / L5 0.030 / PP2116 0.112 / L6 0.035 mm; laminate 1.568 (JLC 1.58 +-10 %), 1.629 with the two 1.2 mil masks; inner copper 1 oz (forced on HDI); TG170 (NP-175F or S1000-2M); Dk 2116 4.29 at 1 GHz (JLC PP library; the emailed stack must state pressed thickness, Dk and frequency), core Dk UNMEASURED (4.6 assumed in every solve; 0.9 ohm sensitivity on the SDRAM far-plane term, 0 on the pair); gaps copper-face to copper-face (to be confirmed). Through-via aspect 7.84:1 (<= 16:1). Request under "Subject to Review": the named stack line by line as above, 2-step L1-L2 + L2-L3 stacked and L6-L5 + L5-L4 stacked, buried L3-L4 0.15 if priced, laser 0.15 (0.12 if accepted) / pad 0.30 (0.27), ENIG, impedance control on the USB pair only, 3 mil selected in the quote (+20 % tier), get it onto the order acknowledgement. Refused with the number that refuses each: N1-2116D 1+4+1 (Structure A); HN1-1078 (placed SDRAM 83 ohm, 0.545 mm to restore); 1080/1078 on L1-L2 and L2-L3 (placed bus 45.2 / 43.1 ohm, restoring 0.105 / 0.092 mm on 607.8 mm of L3/L4 copper = re-route); hybrid 1078 L1-L2 / 2116 L2-L3 (bus 50.2 kept, pair 77.9, rule 0.1235/0.150, custom, and the L2-L3 member of every signal stack still needs hole >= 0.112 so it gains no U1 signal site); 106/1037 outers (USB 63-67 ohm, custom).
microvia: Hole 0.15 mm / land 0.30 mm (ring 0.075), laser, forced by JLC's aspect <= 1:1 (hole >= 0.112 mm of 2116) with their default sizes and pad >= hole + 0.15; 0.112/0.15 = 0.75:1 (0.98:1 even if the 0.035 foil counts). ASK for 0.12 hole / 0.27 land (0.93:1, ring 0.075, inside the 0.075-0.15 range; non-default laser sizes unstated): same 87 U1 sites / 84 simultaneous / 51 stackable, but the interstitial margin to the 0.09 rule becomes +0.0159 mm (+0.0059 under a "BGA pad to copper 0.10" reading, all 87 kept) instead of +0.0009 / -0.0091 (87 -> 40) at 0.15/0.30 (remeasure/sites_0p12.out). Spans: Blind Top->L2-GND, Blind L2-GND->L3-SIG, Blind L4-SIG->L5-VCC3V3, Blind L5-VCC3V3->Bottom (uVia), Buried L3-SIG->L4-SIG (mechanical 0.15/0.27, ring 0.06 so 0.06 + 0.09 = JLC's 0.15 hole-to-trace), Thru 1:6; no skip type. STACKED at one XY (same net), copper-filled; not staggered. VIA-IN-PAD: NO, nowhere -- 0.15 in U1's 0.225 land leaves a 0.0375 ring (0.12: 0.0525) below JLC's 0.075; the only via-in-pad combinations (0.075-in-0.225 on 106/1037, 0.10-in-0.225 on 1078 with a 0.0625-ring waiver) need a custom stack and cost 7.4-22 ohm on the USB pair; a rev-B question only. Pitches (different nets): microvia-microvia 0.39, microvia-through 0.415, microvia-buried 0.39, buried-buried 0.39, through-through 0.44. Plane void 0.48 for a foreign-net microvia on L2/L5 (through 0.70); two foreign-net voids in adjacent 0.5 mm sites leave a 0.02 mm web (< 3 mil) -- alternate sites (diagonal 0.7071 keeps 0.227).

why: The hole follows the prepreg, the prepreg follows the placed SDRAM bus, and the bus is placed. Measured: (1) at U1 the microvia hole/land does not change the site count -- 87 legal sites at 0.075/0.225, 0.10/0.25, 0.12/0.27 and 0.15/0.30 alike, because the board's own 0.09 clearance to the placed Top fan-out copper and to the placed 0.35 lands binds first everywhere and JLC's hole rules never (with ring 0.075 every JLC hole threshold is <= the matching 0.09 land threshold); (2) the only stacks that admit a 0.10 hole under JLC's 1:1 rule put a 1080/1078 prepreg (0.086 / 0.0784) under the SDRAM reference and drop the PLACED 0.125 mm L3/L4 bus (208 tracks, 607.8 mm) to 45.2 / 43.1 ohm, at or below the docs' 45-60 band, wanting 0.105 / 0.092 mm = a re-route of placed copper; the hybrid that keeps the bus (1078 on L1-L2 only) still needs hole >= 0.112 for the L2-L3 member of every signal stack, so it buys no U1 signal site, costs the USB pair 7.4 ohm and is a custom stack; (3) 2116 as JLC name it costs +2.5 ohm on the unplaced USB pair (85.3 -> 87.8, inside +-10 %), +1.2 ohm on the placed SDRAM bus (49.0 -> 50.2, nearer the 8 mA driver), and nothing else -- 0 of 1518 tracks change; (4) 0.15/0.30 is what JLC's published defaults guarantee on 0.112 mm (0.75:1; 0.98:1 even counting the foil), and its one weakness -- the 47 interstitial sites sit 0.9 um inside the 0.09 rule and vanish under a 0.10 BGA-pad reading -- is exactly what the 0.12/0.27 fab question repairs (15.9 um / 5.9 um) without changing the stack; (5) via-in-pad is the only lever that reaches ring 0 and every version of it needs a different custom stack, so it is a rev-B question, not this order; (6) JLC 2-step is $309.34 (qty 5) against $495.01 for PCBWay's 1+N+1 with no 2+N+2 price, and the 1-step alternative is Structure A, which rips 288 inner tracks. Every absolute impedance carries +-5 ohm of mask-model spread and the 2116 Dk comes from a different source than today's 4.10, so the stack review must return pressed thickness, Dk and JLC's own pair figure before the DiffPairsRouting value is frozen.
